exposure: Conservative management (dietary restriction of fat, physical rest)
Sclerotherapy with 10% povidone iodine and 25% dextrose
outcome: Resolution of chyluria (urine color, routine examination of urine, post prandial chyle in urine)
Complications (clot retention, fever, hematuria, abdominal pain)
cohort: The study included 43 pregnant patients diagnosed with chyluria who presented to the Urology department between July 2003 and June 2014.
finding: Sclerotherapy with 10% povidone iodine and 25% dextrose was found to be a safe and effective treatment during pregnancy for symptomatic relief of chyluria, showing a high response rate (86.2%) in short term follow-up.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was an option for three near-term patients who were resistant cases not responding to sclerotherapy.
